quote: The ghosts of our past will never truly leave us. They linger in shadows of familiar rooms. They whisper your deepest regrets in the dark. We carry heavy loads we refuse to drop. Every memory becomes a weight upon the soul. Stop looking backward through the fog of regret. The past is just a lesson, not your permanent home.
